preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= xi <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= yi <= 10**9 for xi, yi in points)
preconditions.description: All points must have coordinates within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.
The number of points provided must match the specified n.

postconditions.description: The number of points m in the good superset must be at least n and at most 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= xi <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= yi <= 10**9 for xi, yi in superset)
postconditions.description: All points in the superset must have coordinates within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all((xi1 == xi2 or yi1 == yi2 or any((xi1 <= xi3 <= xi2 and yi1 <= yi3 <= yi2) for xi3, yi3 in superset)) for (xi1, yi1), (xi2, yi2) in combinations(superset, 2))
postconditions.description: For any two points in the superset, at least one of the three conditions must be true.
